final_answer: Hypothesis: Introduction pathways interact with minimum residence time (mrt) to influence the success of non-native plant species in Catalonia. Specifically, species introduced through "Unintentional" pathways may have a higher invaded niche breadth and area of occupancy compared to those introduced through "AgriForest" or "Gardening" pathways, especially when they have a longer mrt. This hypothesis is based on the observed mean values of mrt and invasion success metrics for each introduction pathway in the dataset. However, due to the limitations in performing statistical tests, the statistical significance of this relationship could not be determined.
